newsitem.title: USA: Bally Total Fitness to offer branded credit card.
newsitem.headline: Bally Total Fitness to offer branded credit card.

text.p: Bally Total Fitness Holding Corp said Tuesday it will offer its health club members a co-branded MasterCard credit card in conjunction with a unit Metris Cos Inc.

The company said the program is another step in its effort to expand beyond its core business and enhance membership value. The Direct Merchants bank unit of Metris will market the Bally Total Fitness MasterCard directly to members, Bally said.
Bally Total Fitness operates 320 fitness centers in 27 states and Canada.
Its shares were off 1/16 Tuesday at 6-3/16.
